dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Presence of multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-pigment rings against a dark dorsal-lateral background. A prominent closed 'O' structure in the upper central region exhibits jagged outer boundaries and a sharp gradient transition from a dark exterior to a significantly lighter interior. Adjacent structures show varying arc completeness and perimeter thickness.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low-density distribution of localized, high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily situated in the upper-right dorsal region and transitioning toward the neck.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent upper-mid torso annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle. An additional secondary linear cluster of smaller high-intensity blobs is observable posterior to the primary grouping.
